findings.text: non-blocking: scratch_root() re-implements node-local scratch-root resolution that the repository already owns at reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:765 (worker_scratch_root), and duplicates stdlib tempfile.gettempdir() on top of that. It duplicates rather than extends the owner, and it honours a TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP value that the owner's own docstring rejects on the stated ground that a shared-storage TMPDIR moves scratch onto GPFS -- so the docstring and evidence claim 'node-local temporary storage' holds only when the host's TMPDIR happens to be node-local.

non-blocking: base_checkout's finally suppresses a TimeoutExpired or OSError from 'git worktree remove' and then rmtree's the scratch directory, so the tree directory is gone while the repository's worktree admin still holds the registration; nothing prunes it and each timeout leaves a dangling entry that accumulates in git worktree list.

non-blocking: the except (OSError, ValueError) wraps measure_run as well as the base_checkout context manager, so any OSError or ValueError raised inside measure_run is reported as 'the base checkout could not be built', mislabelling the provenance of an unreadable measurement; the verdict is safe (unreadable, landing refused) but the recorded guard names the wrong step.

non-blocking: assert runs.read_pointer(RUN)["suite_evidence"]["head"] == head compares the stored head against the same head value the test itself passed to Measurement(head=head) at :658, so it holds whatever Measurement.from_dict does. The test's real guard is the refuse() stub at :665 that raises if the suite is re-measured; this assertion adds nothing to that.

Four files, all inside the declared scope.

justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:371-385 measures at most one delivered run per pass and refuses on an unreadable measurement, which is what keeps the landing pass from stalling the admission loop it now runs inside.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:259 scratch_root() duplicates reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:765 worker_scratch_root without extending it, and ignores that owner's documented reason for not reading TMPDIR.
